summary: The RPSB replied to the West End Advisory Council in January 1972, reminding it of the program's responsibilities and limitations as well as the community's overall goals and objectives.
text: In January, 1972, the RPSB replied to the West End Advisory Council and reminded the Council of the responsibilities and limitations of the program as well as the communities overall goals and objectives.
